name: AI Task Export
desc: Uses AI (Claude or OpenAI, your choice) to turn handwritten to-dos into tasks in your task manager (currently Amazing Marvin). Send a page, chosen pages, a whole note, headings you mark, a lasso selection, or selected document text. Uses your own API keys, stored only on this device (MyStyle/SnMarvin/settings.note) or in a key file you place in MyStyle. Note images and text are sent only to the AI service you select (api.anthropic.com or api.openai.com); task titles and notes are sent to serv.amazingmarvin.com. Nothing else leaves the device.
author: ddpedersen
